_readme: Revisions layered over the generated quests (content/quests/<key>.json) when they load, so rebuilding a quest from its workbook PDF never loses them. guide: a bare-label prompt becomes a guiding question (the old text stays as the card label). replace: rewrites a prompt. split: one long prompt becomes two. drop: removes a prompt folded into another. add: new prompts (phase 0-3) carrying the IP through The IV Phases™ and outward to the Omnidirectional Enterprise™; appended in a closing section unless placed with after/before. shortPath: the node ids of the short path offered on long quests. Answered from the owner's IP analysis, November 2026.
